title: Console host prerequisites
responsibility: Checks console-install prerequisites and reports dependency or bundled-size warnings without installing files.

inputs.name: installableHost.options
inputs.description: SvelteKit host directory, console base segment, existing $lib policy module/export, update/keep choice and optional bucket binding/prefix.

inputs.name: hostWarnings.host
inputs.description: Host directory whose package.json should be checked.

inputs.name: hostWarnings.compressedBytes
inputs.description: Compressed bundled-history size in bytes to compare with the helper’s configured Worker threshold.

outputs.name: installableHost
outputs.description: Resolves with no value when host structure, base, option combinations, storage names and policy export text pass; reads files but performs no installation.

outputs.name: hostWarnings
outputs.description: Warnings for a missing @dafuga01/harness dependency and for compressed history above the configured 3 MiB free threshold, mentioning the configured 10 MiB paid limit.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown for missing SvelteKit structure, invalid base/storage options, conflicting update/keep or absent policy module/export.
